verdict.rationale: Linear exposes a full GraphQL public API with OAuth2/personal keys, webhooks, a typed SDK, and MCP server, covering most CRUD and workflow operations (issues, projects, comments, agents) programmatically. However, the evidence pack does not confirm parity for newer UI-only features like Loops, Guided Reviews, coding-session UI, pinned tabs, or admin spend-limit controls being fully API-accessible, so full UI/API parity is unproven.
